description:
READ-ONLY, and MANDATORY after cloudflare_apply and in every acceptance check: does the
    origin still answer people who skip Cloudflare? Runs the exact attack from this machine -
    `curl --resolve <host>:443:<origin-ip>` on :443 and :80 - and compares it with the answer
    through Cloudflare.

    Verdict is one word and it is a verdict, not a warning:
      OPEN   - the origin answered directly. The configuration is UNFINISHED. Cloudflare
               Access, the WAF and the rate limits are all bypassable by anyone who knows the
               address, and the address is easy to find in historical DNS. Fix: origin_lock.
      CLOSED - direct requests refused, Cloudflare still serving. This is the goal state.
      CLOSED_BUT_CF_BROKEN - direct refused but visitors are not being served either.
      UNKNOWN - could not measure; treated as NOT closed (never reported as a pass).

    Nothing is changed and no page body is read - only the status line and whether Cloudflare
    handled the request. Pass every hostname on the box in extra_hosts (a status/monitoring
    subdomain behind Cloudflare Access is exactly the one that gets forgotten).
name: origin_bypass_check
